app.onboarding.appearance.description.message: Theme, accent, custom launcher background, and window effects all live here. Make the launcher feel familiar.

app.onboarding.brewing.description.message: Choose an input, reagent and output. Potion conditions are optional, and output components can be edited as validated JSON. Brewing recipes require Minecraft 26.3.

app.onboarding.browse.description.message: Search available sources together. Matching titles are candidates until their files are verified. Project pages keep versions, changelogs, galleries, and install options in one place. Installation previews expand required dependencies; use + to add an optional dependency and resolve its requirements. When automatic dependency installation is off, use + to explicitly add missing required dependencies.

app.onboarding.create.description.message: Start from scratch or bring in an existing instance or modpack. Your call.

app.onboarding.creation-confirm.descript.message: This creates the instance with your choices. I keep a strict hands-off policy.

app.onboarding.creation-loader.descripti.message: Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, and friends. Pick what your content needs.

app.onboarding.creation-name.description.message: Pick a name your future self will recognize at a glance.

app.onboarding.creation-version.descript.message: Choose the Minecraft version for this instance. Compatibility likes specifics.

app.onboarding.creation.description.message: Start fresh with a custom setup, or import an existing instance or modpack. Your call.

app.onboarding.defaults.description.message: New instances inherit these choices, so you do not have to repeat the homework.

app.onboarding.discover.description.message: Modpacks, mods, plugins, resource packs, shaders: the good kind of rabbit hole.

app.onboarding.downloads-page.descriptio.message: Active work, history, errors, retries, cancellations, and diagnostics all leave a paper trail here.

app.onboarding.downloads.description.message: Installations and content downloads report in here, so nothing has to disappear mysteriously.

app.onboarding.favorites.description.message: Open Favorites to revisit saved mods, resource packs, data packs, and shaders. The launcher refreshes their project details, then you can choose an instance and add mixed sources to the same install cart.

app.onboarding.home-customize.descriptio.message: Use the bottom-right edit control to add, resize, and configure widgets. While editing, switch between an automatically packed grid and a free grid that preserves empty cells.

app.onboarding.home-layout.description.message: Use the bottom-right control to switch between Information Home and Minimal Home. Widget editing stays with Information Home.

app.onboarding.home-widgets.description.message: Information Home is built from widgets for recent activity, playtime, instances, worlds, and servers. The grid reflows as the window or account sidebar changes.

app.onboarding.instance-actions.descript.message: Launch, stop, repair, configure, export, or open the instance from its header. Export verifies all exportable files once in the background while you choose categories, adjust files, and fill in package information. Changing selections reuses that verification. You can queue the export before verification finishes and follow its progress in Downloads.

app.onboarding.instance-tabs.description.message: Use these tabs for content, files, screenshots, worlds, and logs. Filter content by installation platform or ownership. Duplicate resources start collapsed; expand a group to inspect each file or update every updatable copy together. Installations, Mod updates, and version switches use a dependency preview. Review missing or conflicting dependencies before continuing; use + to add optional dependencies. Compatibility exceptions apply only to the selected release and dimension. Restore recorded updates from verified history backups, or open Old files and backups in the content toolbar to search, select, and review manual cleanup. Content download settings control Chinese filenames and preserved local prefixes and suffixes.

app.onboarding.java.description.message: The Java runtimes that start Minecraft live here. Technical, but well-behaved.

app.onboarding.lab-editor.description.message: Edit text, choose colors, preview the result, and copy the format your Minecraft setup expects.

app.onboarding.lab-editor.title.message: Build and copy in one place

app.onboarding.lab-recipe-generator.desc.message: Pick a Java version, fill the recipe slots, and copy or export the JSON locally.

app.onboarding.lab-schematic.description.message: Open a local .litematic or .schem file, or choose one from an installed instance. The 3D workspace keeps viewing, measurement, layer controls, materials, and local edits together.

app.onboarding.lab-schematic.title.message: Inspect a build before placing it

app.onboarding.lab-seed-map.description.message: Enter a seed or load one from an instance, then inspect biomes, structures, and ore layers on the local map.

app.onboarding.lab-seed-map.title.message: Find a world before you load it

app.onboarding.lab-tools.description.message: Create formatted text and recipe data packs, explore Java worlds, and inspect schematic builds without leaving the launcher.

app.onboarding.lab.description.message: The Lab keeps local Minecraft tools inside the launcher, without another website or account.

app.onboarding.language.description.message: Switch the launcher UI language here, or keep System language. Content translation for project pages is configured on this page too.

app.onboarding.library-page.description.message: Filter by modpack, server, or custom setup, then open any instance to manage it.

app.onboarding.library.description.message: Instances keep versions, loaders, content, and saves separate. No accidental mod soup.

app.onboarding.logagent-cloud.descriptio.message: Cloud options appear when Cloud LogShare is selected. Analyze without storing logs still sends content to LogShare and disables the automatic summary. Cancelling disconnects the launcher; a cloud task may continue on the server.

app.onboarding.logagent-sharing.descript.message: Choosing local analysis does not upload logs to LogShare. You can still explicitly share a diagnostic link using your selected sharing service.

app.onboarding.logagent-source.descripti.message: Local LogAgent investigates logs in this launcher using your configured model. Relevant excerpts are sent to that model provider. Cloud LogShare analyzes logs on its server. The crash window shows live progress and keeps the completed steps in a collapsible history. This setting is a default; the crash window can override it for one analysis.

app.onboarding.offline-account.descripti.message: Open Playing as in the sidebar to add an offline Minecraft account. You may need to sign in with an official Minecraft account on this device first.

app.onboarding.privacy.description.message: Manage anonymous telemetry, Discord Rich Presence, and the Minecraft log analysis service whenever you need to.

app.onboarding.resources.description.message: Choose how content downloads and installs, including your preferred resource source. Modrinth is the default; changing the description source only changes what you read.

app.onboarding.seed-map-area.description.message: Hold the right mouse button and drag on the 2D map to select an area. Count mineral candidate blocks at a chosen height range, or search supported container loot by item name or ID. Results include prediction limits and can be canceled. A right-click without dragging still adds a marker.

app.onboarding.seed-map-underground.desc.message: Underground opens the 3D X-Ray view directly. Click to look around, move with WASD, use Space / Shift to rise or descend, and press Esc to release the mouse. Idle computation preloads full-height 16 × 16 chunks up to a horizontal radius of 12 chunks. Surface and bedrock layers can be switched independently. The upper-left overlay shows your position and the targeted block; the upper-right status shows the loaded chunk count and whether generation is running. Fluids and bedrock thickness are estimates; mineral positions are candidates.

app.onboarding.seed-map.description.message: Zoom in to see supported 2D structure layouts directly on the map. Select a structure to open its capabilities and details beside the map; drag the divider to resize. In Layout, supported structures can switch between frames and original template blocks colored from their textures. Partial layouts, representative palettes and height limits are explained in the preview.

app.onboarding.settings.description.message: Appearance, language, AI providers, launch defaults, content downloads, and privacy all live here.

app.onboarding.skins-page.description.message: Add, preview, sort, and apply skins here. No pressure to sign in just yet.

app.onboarding.skins.description.message: Keep your Minecraft skins together. Signing in can wait until you feel like it.

app.onboarding.translation.description.message: Translate Modrinth project titles, summaries, and descriptions while you browse. Keep the original, show both, or make the translation the main character.

app.onboarding.updates.description.message: Choose when Axolotl checks for updates and whether it installs them for you.

app.onboarding.welcome.description.message: Your instances, content, worlds, and downloads now have one home. Let us take a quick lap before you settle in.
